title: AEC Hackathon submission output (output.json)
description: What run.sh must write to $OUTPUT_PATH. Duplicate reports of the same error do not raise recall and they lower precision.

document.description: File name of the document that contains the INCORRECT information.

location.description: Where the error appears: page, section, table, or equipment mark. Page numbers and distinctive values here help your report match the answer key.

description.description: One sentence. Quote the wrong value and the correct value — the grader matches on the distinctive strings you mention.

id.description: Optional. If you somehow know the answer-key id, echoing it guarantees the match.
